description: For every coherent family of coinfinite injections below omega one, its finite-modification tree is an aleph-one-Aronszajn tree, has countable levels, and every branch is countable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree_spec
  (s : (a : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.OmegaOne) → ↑(Set.Iio a) → ℕ)
  (hs : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCoherentFamily s) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsAronszajnTree (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree s hs)
      (Cardinal.aleph 1) ∧
    (∀ a < Ordinal.omega 1,
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree s hs)
            a).Countable) ∧
      ∀ (B : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree s hs).carrier),
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsBranch (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.aronszajnTree s hs) B →
          B.Countable
